description.en: A curated directory of native DSH bundles.
description.zh: 由我们维护的 DSH 原生插件目录。

description.en: Original iPolloWork Design editor with native right-panel and left-navigation settings.
description.zh: 原版 Design 编辑器，可独立配置右侧白板与左侧导航。

description.en: Original iPolloWork Video editor with native right-panel and left-navigation settings.
description.zh: 原版 Video 编辑器，可独立配置右侧白板与左侧导航。

description.en: Refresh session titles as new prompts arrive.
description.zh: 根据新输入更新会话标题。
Minimal independent plugin package for local development.
description.en: Minimal independent plugin package for local development.

description.zh: 通过版本感知的官方文档检索，为实现、升级和技术决策提供可追溯的上下文。
description.en: Retrieve version-aware official documentation for traceable implementation, upgrade, and technical decisions.

description.zh: 使用当前 DSH 原生 Agent、子任务和会话完成开发、审查与研究，无需第二套运行时。
description.en: Use the current native DSH Agent, subagent tools and sessions for development, review and research.

description.zh: 管理抖音本地草稿、素材、作品及评论记录，通过平台 API 和原生会话继续运营；隔离网页账号自动接入暂不可用。
description.en: Manage local Douyin drafts, assets, posts and comment records through platform APIs and native conversation. Isolated browser account onboarding is unavailable.

description.zh: 完整的 Figma 设计到代码、Code Connect、设计系统和画布写入工作流。
description.en: Complete Figma design-to-code, Code Connect, design system, and canvas authoring workflows.

description.zh: 检查仓库、处理 PR 与 Issue、诊断 Actions，并把本地修改安全发布为 Draft PR。
description.en: Inspect repositories, handle pull requests and issues, diagnose Actions, and safely publish local changes as a draft pull request.

description.zh: 安装即用的业务数据工作台：内置 SQLite，管理项目、业务表、关系图和文档；项目 MCP 复用 iPolloWork AI。可选连接 PostgreSQL 独立项目。
description.en: Ready-to-use business workspace with built-in SQLite: projects, tables, relationships, documents, and scoped project MCP. External PostgreSQL projects are optional.

description.zh: Jev 为多种 Agent Harness 提供结构化决策能力，辅助选择工具、Skill 和 Agent，进行评分与判断；由当前 Agent 执行。
description.en: Jev provides structured decisions for agent harnesses, helping select tools, Skills, and agents, score results, and make judgments. The current agent executes the selected actions.

description.zh: 多模态数据标注工作台：真实素材实训、文档导入、标注员/审核员切换、本地记录审核及通过后导出 JSON。
description.en: A multimodal annotation workbench with real training media, document import, local annotator/reviewer modes, saved-record review, and approved JSON exports.

description.zh: 把问题分流、Sprint 规划、交付跟进和项目更新组合成一致的 Linear 工作流。
description.en: Combine issue triage, sprint planning, delivery follow-up, and project updates into a consistent Linear workflow.

description.zh: 本地素材创作与管理，使用账号已授权模型生成图片、视频和语音；部分旧版高级编辑模式待适配。
description.en: Create and manage local assets with authorized image, video and speech models. Some former advanced editing modes need further adaptation.

description.zh: 将 Notion 页面、数据库、项目文档和会议记录组合成可靠的知识工作流。
description.en: Combine Notion pages, databases, project documents, and meeting notes into reliable knowledge workflows.

description.zh: 统一 Node.js 录制器，记录页面、区域和控件，将详细操作步骤编译成可复用 Skill。
description.en: Turn a demonstration into an editable, parameterized, portable Skill.

description.zh: 在原生会话中制作、检查和打包 DSH 插件，通过原生插件管理器安装与验证。
description.en: Author, check and package native DSH plugins in conversation, then install and verify them with the native Plugin Manager.

description.zh: 为视频、演示文稿、网页和其他模板提供共用的参考资料 Skill。
description.en: Shared reference evidence Skill for video, slides, websites and other templates.

description.zh: 把生产问题调查、回归监控、发布健康和修复验证组合成有证据的 Sentry 工作流。
description.en: Combine production issue investigation, regression monitoring, release health, and fix verification into evidence-backed Sentry workflows.

description.zh: 节点画布、分镜、剧本、角色与素材管理，连接已授权生成能力并交给原生 Video 编辑；部分旧版生成模式待适配。
description.en: Manage a node canvas, storyboards, scripts, characters and assets with authorized generation and native Video editing. Some former generation modes need further adaptation.

description.zh: 把支付调查、订阅与账单、对账和高风险操作审查组合成安全的 Stripe 工作流。
description.en: Combine payment investigation, subscriptions and billing, reconciliation, and high-risk operation review into safe Stripe workflows.

description.zh: 管理视频号本地草稿、视频封面素材与运营任务，在原生会话中继续工作；隔离网页账号自动接入暂不可用。
description.en: Manage local WeChat Channels drafts, video covers and operation tasks in native conversation. Isolated browser account onboarding is unavailable.

description.zh: 通过微信公众号平台 API 管理账号、图文、草稿、消息与运营工作流；隔离网页账号接入暂不可用。
description.en: Manage WeChat Official Accounts, articles, drafts, messages and operations through platform APIs. Isolated browser accounts are unavailable.

description.zh: A minimal MCP App canvas that can be edited by people and agents.
description.en: A minimal MCP App canvas that can be edited by people and agents.

description.zh: 管理小红书本地账号记录、草稿、素材与运营任务；隔离网页账号和自动验证暂不可用。
description.en: Manage local Xiaohongshu account records, drafts, assets and operation tasks. Isolated browser accounts and automatic verification are unavailable.
